title: Verify: menuClose closes the ActionMenu and unsubscribes on unmount
acceptance_criteria: After objectClick the menu is shown; after menuClose it is gone.
technical_constraints: Copy the mocks (PhaserHost, API client, content) from game/frontend/tests/appObjectClick.test.tsx

steps.action: Reuse the setup of appObjectClick.test.tsx to reach the playing view. Test 1: act(() => phaserToReact.emit('objectClick',{id:<object id used in appObjectClick>})), assert ActionMenu present, act(() => phaserToReact.emit('menuClose',{})), assert ActionMenu absent. Test 2: spy on phaserToReact.on, unmount, assert the returned unsubscribe was invoked or that a later menuClose emit causes no state update.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appMenuClose.test.tsx
